title: Turkey
blurb: Turkey, officially the Republic of Türkiye, is a country mainly located in Anatolia in West Asia, with a smaller part called East Thrace in Southeast Europe.
facts: Turkey is home to over 86 million people; most are ethnic Turks, while Kurds are the largest ethnic minority.
Officially a secular state, Turkey has a Muslim-majority population.
Ankara is Turkey's capital and second-largest city.
